newsitem.title: USA: SCI Systems Inc Q3 March 31 net rises.
newsitem.headline: SCI Systems Inc Q3 March 31 net rises.

text.p: SCI Systems Inc said third quarter sales rose 18.6 percent to $1.32 billion from $1.11 billion last year. Net income rose 36.7 percent to $26.1 million from $19.1 million in the same quarter a year ago.
Earnings per share for the quarter were $.86 on a primary basis and $.78 on a fully diluted basis, compared with $.63 in the prior year on both a primary and fully diluted basis.
For the nine months, sales rose 32.2 percent to $4.2 billion from $3.2 billion. Net income rose 43.2 percent to $80.8 million compared with $56.4 million a year earlier.
Earnings per share for the first nine months were $2.66 on a primary basis and $2.41 fully diluted compared with $1.88 a year earlier on both a primary and fully diluted basis.
Return on average shareholders' equity was 20.9% for the first nine month period.
Quarter and order backlog was $2.81 billion compared with $2.45 billion a year earlier. Component lead times and component prices have both significantly declined over the past year.
